verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has a first-party TypeDoc API reference (e.g., the NullEngine class page) and an official interactive Playground code editor with sharing at playground.babylonjs.com. Community comments also praise the documentation. However, no evidence shows the reference pages themselves include or link to runnable examples, so the two pieces are documented separately. missing for 10: evidence that API reference entries embed or link to runnable Playground examples, depth of interactive features in the reference itself, hands-on corroboration of an integrated reference-plus-examples experience.
